experiment_title: Controlled Cross-Architecture Service Replacement & Modularity Experiment
research_question: How much effort and architectural disruption is required to replace an existing service/model while preserving the surrounding decision workflow?

evaluated_replacement.replacement_model: Holt-Winters Additive Triple Exponential Smoothing with weekly seasonality
evaluated_replacement.replacement_service_contract: Input: series/category + horizon; Output: lead-time demand projection

retailops_mcp.pattern_description: Microservice architecture communicating via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool contracts.
developer_steps_description: Implement replacement service satisfying getForecast FastMCP schema
Update server command path in client configuration file
retailops_mcp.surrounding_workflow_impact: Zero disruption; orchestrator and other microservices execute without code modifications.

flowr_coordinator.pattern_description: Centralized Reasoning Coordinator mediating modular domain functions (Bandara et al., 2026).
flowr_coordinator.bounded_reproduction_disclaimer: Bounded algorithmic pattern reproduction; not proprietary weights or production environment.
developer_steps_description: Implement adapted domain tools class inheriting FlowrDomainTools
Override forecast_demand static method with statistical model
Subclass FlowrCoordinatorDecisionProvider to rewire tool instance binding
Update call sites to instantiate adapted coordinator
flowr_coordinator.surrounding_workflow_impact: Requires object-oriented subclassing or in-place method replacement; no runtime configuration layer.

workflowllm_generative.pattern_description: Plan-then-Execute Generative Workflow with dynamic parameter binding (Fan et al., ICLR 2025).
workflowllm_generative.bounded_reproduction_disclaimer: Bounded algorithmic pattern reproduction; not proprietary weights or production environment.
workflowllm_generative.service_isolation_level: Plan Schema & Dispatcher Binding (In-process generative dispatch)
developer_steps_description: Modify Phase 1 plan generation schema to insert explicit statistical forecast step
Update required inputs and output keys across plan steps
Add Phase 2 executor operation dispatch branch for statistical forecast
Rewire intermediate execution state parameter binding into downstream target synthesis
workflowllm_generative.surrounding_workflow_impact: Requires coordinated modifications across both Phase 1 plan schema and Phase 2 executor dispatch loop.

agentic_replenishment.pattern_description: Direct Single-Domain Autonomous Replenishment Loop (Syed et al., ICBDT 2025).
agentic_replenishment.bounded_reproduction_disclaimer: Bounded algorithmic pattern reproduction; not proprietary weights or production environment.
developer_steps_description: Subclass or duplicate monolithic agent class
Locate inline demand calculation equations within monolithic decide() method
Splice in statistical forecast calculation and adjust reorder point equations
Re-verify tightly-coupled downstream threshold and ordering logic
agentic_replenishment.surrounding_workflow_impact: Lack of modular boundaries requires duplicating or rewriting the entire perception-action control loop.
